entities.summary: The Army of Free Lebanon – AFL, also known variously as the Colonel Barakat's Army or Armée du Liban Libre (ALL) and Armée du Colonel Barakat in French, was a predominantly Christian splinter faction of the Lebanese Army that came to play a major role in the 1975–77 phase of the Lebanese Civil War.
